title: Diverticulitis, home; summary DNR vs CM full code, 'None pending' contradicted by its own hospital course, and nursing antibiotics differ

rationale.goals_of_care: The summary says DNR/DNI (confirmed 11/11) but the later CM note records the patient now wants full code and asked for the order to be updated; the record contradicts itself on code status.
rationale.pending_results: 'None pending' contradicts the hospital course, which says blood cultures from 11/15 'remain in process at the time of discharge', and no one is named to follow them.
rationale.meds_consistent: The summary lists amoxicillin-clavulanate; the nursing instructions list ciprofloxacin and metronidazole instead.
rationale.med_changes: The summary's change list is complete for its own medication list; the nursing mismatch is scored under meds_consistent.
rationale.pac_list: Home without services, so the post-acute rules do not apply.
